body.statement: Implementation corollary (definitional normalization). If every selection probability \(s_e=P_{\vartheta}(S=1\mid E=e)\) is known and positive, then the population margin is identified by \(m_e=(r_e/s_e)/\sum_{f\in\mathcal E}(r_f/s_f)\). The IV-plus-proxy implementation with known selection therefore intersects \(\mathcal C_B(T)\) with this normalized value of \(m\).
body.justification: This is a definitional reweighting used to instantiate the application fiber, not a claimed research contribution.
body.gap: The identity is elementary normalization of observed selected-cell margins by known selection probabilities.
body.consumer: The GEUVADIS implementation uses the population margins implied by its imposed selection scheme.
